headline: Oil Eases Near Three-Month Lows Despite Hormuz Naval Mine Explosions
summary: Brent crude futures fell to near $88.97 per barrel as rising global crude supply offset concerns over naval mine explosions targeting three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical maritime transit choke point for crude oil shipments from Gulf producers.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Futures prices fell due to expanding global crude production balancing shipping risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising supply expectations outweighed physical disruption risks caused by maritime safety incidents in Middle Eastern shipping lanes.
